effects.printed_clause: During the Main Phase, if this card is in your hand (Quick Effect): Place it face-up in your Spell & Trap Zone as a Continuous Trap.
effects.lua_implementation: A hand Main Phase Quick Effect moves and trapifies the handler in an open Spell & Trap Zone.

effects.printed_clause: While treated as a Continuous Trap: Set 1 Gravinity Spell/Trap directly from your Deck; if it is your opponent's turn, it can be activated this turn.
effects.lua_implementation: A free-chain Quick Effect in the Spell & Trap Zone requires Trap type/free zone, Sets a Gravinity Spell/Trap, and on opponent's turn grants EFFECT_TRAP_ACT_IN_SET_TURN or EFFECT_QP_ACT_IN_SET_TURN where needed through End Phase.

official_references.matched_structure: Sets a Trap and permits activation in the Set turn.
Sets an archetype Spell/Trap directly from Deck.

effects.printed_clause: While treated as a Continuous Trap: Move this card to another column.
effects.lua_implementation: A separate Quick Effect selects an empty own Spell & Trap Zone and moves the handler.

effects.printed_clause: You can only use each effect of Gravinity Star once per turn.
effects.lua_implementation: The three effects use id/id+100/id+200 hard once-per-turn keys.

effects.printed_clause: Support implementation for Spell & Trap Zone Synchro material.
effects.lua_implementation: The extra Synchro material helper now permits only Gravinity Lapsix and Gravinity Galaxix as destination monsters.
effects.issue: Confirmed and corrected: the old all-Gravinity-Synchro predicate over-permitted Nebulix and Spherix.

coverage_override.reason: Five records cover hand placement, Deck Set choice, column movement choice, per-effect HOPT, and destination-scoped extra-material support.
